app_info.subtitle: Coordinate work and runners
app_info.description: Stensibly helps users inspect and coordinate exact work, dispatch runner-neutral tasks to authorised execution targets, review bounded receipts, and perform guarded GitHub issue, CI, and publication workflows through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Attaches a durable artifact reference to an existing Stensibly work item.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only the private Stensibly workspace and does not publish the referenced content externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a reference without deleting or overwriting existing work records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes an exact work item to blocked state and releases its current lease.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only governed state inside the Stensibly workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replaces the item's active state and clears its current responsibility lease under a generation fence.

justifications.read_only_justification: Acquires a time-bounded responsibility lease on an exact work item.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only governed state inside the Stensibly workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Changes who may act on the item and excludes competing claims until the lease ends.

justifications.read_only_justification: Marks exact work complete, clears its lease, and may create bounded continuation proposals.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only governed state inside the Stensibly workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Applies a terminal state transition that replaces the item's active responsibility state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new task, finding, question, decision, tip, handoff, or note in Stensibly.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates a record only in the private Stensibly workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new record without deleting or overwriting existing work.

justifications.read_only_justification: Claims an exact work generation and queues one runner-neutral execution run.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes Stensibly work and run state while the selected runner owns any physical execution.
justifications.destructive_justification: Starts an execution workflow and changes responsibility under exact generation and idempotency fences.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a compact project briefing without changing work or authority state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the authenticated Stensibly workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, dispatch, or otherwise change state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a deterministic bounded handoff packet with exact work, run, artifact, dependency, and receipt references.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the authenticated Stensibly workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter the item, its history, authority, or any execution.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns accepted repository policy and an advisory setup plan without granting authority.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads project policy inside Stensibly and does not call or change an external provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not accept a proposal or modify project attachment state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Posts one bounded attributed comment to an exact GitHub issue.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes a third-party GitHub repository and may create publicly visible content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Sends an externally visible message that this app cannot erase, with idempotent receipt safeguards.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads exact pull-request, status, workflow, job, and failed-step evidence to produce a CI verdict.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries the external GitHub provider without modifying it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Authorises no provider mutation and changes no repository state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates one GitHub issue with optional labels and assignees.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes a third-party GitHub repository and may create publicly visible content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates an external ticket that this app cannot erase, with an explicit idempotency key to prevent duplicates.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves canonical identity and revision evidence for one GitHub issue while omitting its body.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries the external GitHub provider without modifying it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not post, edit, close, or otherwise change the issue.

justifications.read_only_justification: Merges one exact pull request after checking current authority, source, CI, review, and mergeability fences.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes repository history on the external GitHub provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs an irreversible merge operation guarded by exact revisions, durable reservation, and post-merge verification.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a branch, writes one exact file change, and opens a pull request as one durable workflow.
justifications.open_world_justification: Publishes code and pull-request state to the external GitHub provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates externally visible Git history and review state, with exact-parent and durable receipt safeguards.

justifications.read_only_justification: Checks repository connectivity, binding, exact head, state, catalogue identity, and available operations.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads live facts from the external GitHub provider without modifying them.
justifications.destructive_justification: Authorises no mutation and changes no repository or Stensibly state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches a bounded issue-only scope in one project-bound GitHub repository.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries the external GitHub provider without modifying it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, edit, comment on, or close issues.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates the title, body, or state of one exact GitHub issue.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes issue content or lifecycle state on the external GitHub provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites externally visible issue fields or state under an optimistic revision fence.

justifications.read_only_justification: Releases an exact claim and replaces the item's summary and next action for a successor.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only governed state inside the Stensibly workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Changes current responsibility and overwrites continuation fields under a generation fence.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists current work with optional project and status filters without modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the authenticated Stensibly workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not claim, transition, dispatch, or otherwise alter work.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns an exact blocked item to ready state and may replace its next action.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only governed state inside the Stensibly workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replaces blocker state and continuation guidance under a generation fence.

test_cases.description: Understand the current state of one Stensibly project.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me a compact briefing for my stensibly project and identify the most urgent ready or blocked work.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a compact project briefing with current counts, ready work, blockers, and the next useful action.

test_cases.description: Create and dispatch one exact runner-neutral task.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a bounded task in my glaeda project to query the exact current source on an eligible owned workstation, then dispatch it with the repository query runner profile.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one canonical work item and queues one exact generation-fenced run using the requested runner profile.

test_cases.description: Recover an exact workstation run and bounded receipt from canonical state.
test_cases.user_prompt: Read this Stensibly item and tell me the exact run, execution target, source identity, terminal result reference, and whether it completed successfully.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a bounded canonical packet and identifies the exact run and receipt evidence without inventing machine state.

test_cases.description: Diagnose CI for one exact pull request.
test_cases.user_prompt: Diagnose the current CI state of pull request 1802 in the GitHub repository attached to my stensibly project.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a healthy, pending, or failing verdict tied to the pull request's exact current head and bounded failure evidence.

test_cases.description: Create one guarded GitHub issue from an explicit request.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a GitHub issue in the repository attached to my stensibly project titled 'Measure phone-to-workstation receipt latency' with a short acceptance checklist.
test_cases.expected_output: After the required confirmation, creates one idempotent GitHub issue and returns its durable provider receipt.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for local source editing without a Stensibly workflow request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Refactor this local TypeScript function and run its unit tests.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because ordinary local coding is outside its coordination and governed-provider workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for calendar and scheduling requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow afternoon?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not provide calendar or scheduling data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general public-web research.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find today's most important technology news and summarize it.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because general web research is outside its supported project and repository workflows.
